desc: Understand the reduction to sequence `P` and verify it's correct.
Design a data structure for 2D range LIS queries on `P`: points `(i, P[i])`, query rectangle `[1, K] × [1, R]`, find LIS.
Choose between offline processing by R or K, and pick a segment tree/BIT approach.
Implement the solution in Python, ensuring it runs in `O((N+Q) log N)`.
Test the solution on the sample inputs.
